prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset: top-left tile of a larger pixel-art amusement park game map. Edit the attached image in place and output exactly the same native 1548 × 1124 pixel canvas. This image is a CROP, deliberately containing partial buildings and clipped signs at some edges. Keep all those clipped fragments precisely as clipped. Do not fit a whole map, complete partial structures, expand, shrink or zoom the composition.

PRIMARY REQUEST: author clean fine-resolution 32-bit/SNES-style pixel-art detail INSIDE the existing scenery on this 1548 × 1124 canvas. The reference was mechanically enlarged 2× only to set up a larger drawing canvas. Replace blocky/resampled surface detail with purpose-designed crisp smaller pixel clusters that use the new finer pixel grid, especially readable brickwork, roof tiles, wooden beams, paving stones, coaster rails/supports, foliage highlights and water. This must be actual newly drawn fine pixel detail, not blur, sharpening halos, painterly texture, random noise, giant square blocks or a mere upscale. Match the original warm, cheerful game palette exactly, with clear stepped outlines and restrained 3-5 tone shading per material.

ABSOLUTE GEOMETRY AND SEAM LOCK:
- Keep every road centerline, road edge and width, curve, junction, landmark outline, land/water boundary, sign and object in the exact same pixel position as the attached image. The game walking graph and adjacent map tiles are already defined.
- The full 128-pixel overlap bands along the RIGHT edge (x=1420..1547) and BOTTOM edge (y=996..1123) are PROTECTED: leave them visually and spatially entirely unchanged, including every clipped text fragment, road exit, leaf cluster, building, color and outline. This covers the shared overlap with neighboring tiles.
- Leave at least the outermost 64 pixels along EVERY remaining canvas edge entirely unchanged as well. Do not draw a border or mark the protected bands.
- Do not crop or trim any pixel of the reference footprint. Maintain the current overhead/isometric projection and scale.
- Detail only existing surfaces, transitioning subtly to the unchanged overlap bands. Keep existing grass reasonably quiet. Do not add trees, shrubs, flowers, people, objects, roads, attractions, labels or any element.

Walking paths: retain the identical warm pale-yellow ground color and width; keep unobstructed; at most restrained tiny orderly paving hints inside current paths. Never add trees or foliage onto walking paths.

Text and content: preserve the exact existing lettering and placement, including the accents and any partial labels clipped by the crop. This tile contains MONACO, GRIECHENLAND, FRANKREICH, SCHWEIZ; partial DEUTSCHLAND and EINGANG signs cut by the right crop edge; partial Croatian, Russian and English attractions at bottom. Do not rewrite or reposition signs. Do not insert full labels where the reference has partial ones.

Avoid all UI, map markers, pins, people, panels, new decorations and photographic or painterly detail. Final image is one precisely aligned 1548 × 1124 native PNG tile, with the protected edge strips unchanged.
